sourceFacts.fact: Midgut volvulus can obstruct bowel passage and compromise blood supply.
Compromised perfusion can cause intestinal ischaemia and tissue death.
Bilious vomiting in a neonate warrants urgent assessment.

layout: One top-centre concept card1 splits into two parallel branches: left2, right3 then4 below right. Exactly four nodes and three arrows. Node1 contains a simple neutral warning diamond, not twisted bowel. Node2 a plain straight page arrow with stop bar; node3 a low gauge labelled Supply; node4 a cracked paper tile. Large bottom coral band: Neonatal bilious vomiting needs urgent assessment. Do not draw actual intestinal twist, mesentery, artery, veins, organ silhouettes or malrotation geometry. This is a consequences map only.
